fields.summary: Book and cancel classes as members
fields.description:
Members can book a class up to 7 days before it starts and cancel a booking up to 2 hours before the class starts.

h3. Acceptance Criteria
* Members can book a class up to 7 days before it starts.
* Members can cancel a booking up to 2 hours before the class starts.
* Cancelling frees the place for another member.
* Members receive a booking confirmation after they book.
* Members identify themselves with their membership number.

h3. Source
{quote}S6: "Members can book a class up to 7 days before it starts."{quote}

h3. Dependencies
None stated in brief

h3. Open Questions
* [Q-001] How is the booking confirmation delivered to members?
